grain_clerk_conflict: I entered {dispatch_record}. The independent threshold tally now reads: {threshold_tally}. The roof was poor, not my measure; certify the tablet and let the household keep its reserve.
other_office_conflict: The dispatch docket states: {dispatch_record}. The independent threshold tally records: {threshold_tally}. I ask you to preserve the office's standing—and name who bears the loss.
canal_bailiff_requisition: The requisition was entered because the canal work needs hands. Our office account shows {labor} labor and {barley} barley; that total does not tell you how many hands can leave their posts. I ask you to authorize the allotment, not mistake the stock ledger for a muster.
other_office_requisition: The requisition names {form_title} for {place_name}. The institution records {labor} labor and {barley} barley, but the roll does not show which hands can be spared. Certify the request or write whose stores must be reassigned.
archive_keeper: Do not make a patron's seal into evidence. Enter the source, and let the record name the responsible office.
trusted_complicit: We have kept one another's accounts before. A clean seal now will be remembered in your favor.
hostile_exacting: Do not ask me to soften a figure. Show the source and state plainly who carries the consequence.
general_office: The office asks for a clear finding: certify what the source supports, or refer what it cannot explain.
no_witness: No witness is named in this docket; I cannot offer an account I did not see.
no_separate_demand: No separate demand was entered by this office.
record_entry_summary: The register identifies {form_title} for {place_name}, entered by {generated_by} for {generation_reason} at urgency {urgency}. This establishes the request's origin and stated reason; it does not prove the shortage.

form_demands.bailiff_requisition: I seek authorization for the labor allotment named in this requisition.
form_demands.pension_roll: I seek an assessment of the pension names and their recorded entitlements.
form_demands.grain_levy: I seek an entry for the grain assessed on this levy roll.
form_demands.travel_pass: I seek authorization of the journey and its stated terms.
form_demands.succession_claim: I seek a ruling on which succession entry may be recognized.
form_demands.consignment_receipt: I seek certification of the goods received against this consignment.

generation_reasons.local_institution_shortage: a reported shortage at the institution
